title: Identify the nationality of the oldest driver (earliest date of birth) who
question: Identify the nationality of the oldest driver (earliest date of birth) who participated in a race held at an Austrian circuit and also has at least one lap time recorded for lap number 3.

prediction.sql:
SELECT d."XCL_041"
FROM drivers AS d
WHERE d."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT lt."XCL_044"
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    INNER JOIN races AS rc ON lt."XCL_043" = rc."XCL_065"
    INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON rc."XCL_068" = c."XCL_001"
    WHERE c."XCL_005" = 'Austria'
      AND lt."XCL_045" = 3
)
ORDER BY d."XCL_040" ASC
LIMIT 1

roles.description: Lap time recorded in the first qualifying session (Q1). This is the most frequently populated time column, serving as the baseline for all qualifying entries.

structural_constraints.description: Participation in the second qualifying session (Q2) implies participation in the first qualifying session (Q1). The data confirms this: every row with a Q2 time has a Q1 time, but many rows with a Q1 time do not have a Q2 time.

Participation in the third qualifying session (Q3) implies participation in the second qualifying session (Q2). The data confirms this: every row with a Q3 time has a Q2 time, but many rows with a Q2 time do not have a Q3 time.

JOIN results r ON d.XCL_034 = r.XCL_075
JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
JOIN circuits c ON ra.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.XCL_034 = lt.XCL_044 AND ra.XCL_065 = lt.XCL_043
WHERE c.XCL_004 = 'Austria'
  AND lt.XCL_046 = 3
ORDER BY d.XCL_040 ASC
LIMIT 1

react.raw_react_sql:
SELECT d."XCL_041"
FROM drivers AS d
WHERE d."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT lt."XCL_044"
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    INNER JOIN races AS rc ON lt."XCL_043" = rc."XCL_065"
    INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON rc."XCL_068" = c."XCL_001"
    WHERE c."XCL_005" = 'Austria'
      AND lt."XCL_045" = 3
)
ORDER BY d."XCL_040" ASC
LIMIT 1
